## About
Lawson Auto Center is a car repair and maintenance shop on Donald Lee Hollowell Pkwy NW in northwest Atlanta. Customers know Mr. Lawson by name, and reviewers talk about a business that has been in the family for generations.
People bring us everything from newer trucks to older cars that other shops don't want to touch. A lot of folks come in when their air conditioning quits, and we work on cooling systems and general repairs too.
Stop by Monday through Saturday, or give us a call before you come in.

## Services
- AC work: When your air conditioning stops blowing cold, bring it in. A reviewer recommended the shop especially for AC work.
- Cooling system: One reviewer's truck had a cooling system that was wearing out. We found the root problem and fixed it.
- Vehicle repairs and service: Repairs and routine service for your everyday car or truck.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes. Saturday hours are 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're at 2664 Donald Lee Hollowell Pkwy NW, Atlanta, GA 30318.

Q: Do you work on older cars?
A: Yes. One reviewer brought in a classic '92 Corolla with a dead air conditioner and drove away with it blowing cold.

## What customers say

I came in as an emergency. My 2020 F-150 Platinum EcoBoost started overheating and I was hoping it was something simple — maybe just a hose leak. What Anthony and his team discovered was far more serious.

At 125,000 miles, my gaskets had severely hardened, crystallized, and deteriorated — leaking coolant throughout the engine in multiple places. On top of that, the water pump had aged significantly and was also failing. What I thought was a minor issue turned out to be a cooling system that was quietly breaking down, robbing my truck of performance for longer than I even realized.

What impressed me most was the communication and transparency — not just in the diagnosis, but in the cost and issues my vehicle had. Every step of the way, Sarge and his team were completely honest and open. They didn’t just tell me what was wrong, they showed me, explained it, and made sure I understood exactly what needed to be done and why. The pricing was fair, clearly broken down, and there were no surprise charges or hidden fees. No pressure. Just straight answers and honest numbers.

After the repairs were completed, the difference was night and day. My truck felt more powerful and responsive than it ever has. I even heard my turbos spooling and boosting properly for the first time — that’s how compromised the engine had been running for years!!

Sarge — you were absolutely amazing. Horatio — thank you for keeping us comfortable and at ease throughout the entire process. And learning that Lawson Automotive carries over 50 years of family history in this business explains everything about why the culture here is different. This isn’t a transactional repair shop. These are people who genuinely take pride in their craft and treat every customer like family.

I will be returning for all vehicle repairs and service going forward — personally and for my fleet. If you want a shop that’s honest, thorough, communicates every step, prices fairly, and actually fixes the root problem — Lawson Automotive is the only call you need to make.
